_doc: Known, reasoned exceptions for scripts/contract (npm run test:contract). Every entry needs a reason; remove it once the backend spec is fixed.

undocumentedStatus.POST /v1/tenant/customers 400: Go handler answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (empty name); spec lists only 201/401/403/409
undocumentedStatus.POST /v1/tenant/catalog/categories 409: Go catalog handler maps ErrConflict (duplicate name) to 409 CONFLICT; spec omits it
undocumentedStatus.POST /v1/tenant/catalog/products 409: Go catalog handler maps ErrConflict (duplicate SKU/barcode) to 409 CONFLICT; spec omits it
undocumentedStatus.POST /v1/tenant/jobs/export 400: Go exports handler answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for an unknown format; spec omits 400

specFixes.reason: Spec bug: `oneOf [AIConfirmCard, AIPlan, {type:object}]` can never pass for a confirm card or plan (it also matches the catch-all object). anyOf is the intended meaning.
